production.note: US model years of the 3.0-litre fixed-roof car with the 270 hp manual rating. First: Acura's chronology lists 1991 as "New model". Last: for 1997 Acura says "new 3.2-liter DOHC 24-valve V-6 engine produces 290 hp and 224 lbs-ft torque with 6-speed manual transmission (automatic-equipped models retain 3.0-liter combination)"; the 1996 press kit (acura-nsx-1996-kit) still lists 'Coupe' curb weights with the 3.0-litre engine. The open-roof NSX-T (from 1995) is sold under its own name and is not part of this record. Automatic-equipped cars kept the 3.0-litre engine after 1996; the 1997 press kit (acura-nsx-1997-kit) says "The SportShift automatic transmission-equipped NSX continues to utilize the potent 3.0-liter V-6" (252 hp) but no opened Acura page says whether a fixed-roof automatic was still sold from 1997, so those years are not counted here.

body.note: Acura's 1996 press kit lists the fixed-roof car as 'Coupe' beside the 'Open Top' NSX-T; the 1995 kit (acura-nsx-1995-kit) says "the NSX is now available in hardtop or removable top models".

aspiration.note: Inferred: 'Induction System: Programmed Fuel Injection (PGM-FI) with Variable Volume Induction System'; no turbocharger or supercharger is listed.

transmission.note: '5-speed Manual'; '4-speed Automatic with electronically controlled lockup torque converter'. From 1995 the automatic gained SportShift manual control (acura-nsx-chronology).

powerHp.note: Manual car. Quote: "270 hp @7100 RPM - 5-speed 252 hp @6600 RPM - Automatic". The 4-speed automatic is rated 252 hp. Same ratings on Acura's 1992 and 1993 sheets (acura-nsx-1992-specs, acura-nsx-1993-specs).

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 5-speed manual, 1991 model. Quote: "3010lbs. (1365 kg) - 5-speed 3098lbs. (1405 kg)- Automatic". Acura's 1992 sheet repeats 3,010 lb; the 1993 sheet gives 3,020 lb and the 1996 press kit 3,047 lb for the manual coupe.

discrepancies.reason: Model year. All three are Acura curb weights for the manual fixed-roof car: 3,010 lb on the 1991 and 1992 sheets, 3,020 lb on the 1993 sheet (passenger airbag added), 3,047 lb in the 1996 press kit.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,010 lb because the reference model year is 1991.
